IS 8820 : Part 1 : 2024 Towing Hooks - Part 1 Scale of Tractive Efforts
ICS 47.060
ICS 47.060
TED 18
TED 18
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) specifies the scale of tractive efforts applicable to towing hooks used on tugs of all types and purposes.
2 REFERENCES
Standard contains no cross referenced Indian Standard.
